channel.title: Just Women's Sports - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Just Women's Sports (justwomenssports.com)

item.title: Top Seeds Survive Early March Madness Scares to Book Sweet Sixteen Tickets
item.description: A full half of the NCAA women's basketball tournament's Sweet Sixteen field is locked, as Women's March Madness continues this week.

item.title: Boxer Isis Sio in Medically Induced Coma After 1st-Round Knockout
item.description: Boxer Isis Sio was placed in a medically induced coma, after suffering serious injuries during her first-round knockout loss on Saturday.

item.title: Portland Thorns Make Red Card History in Cascadia Rivalry Win Over Seattle
item.description: The Portland Thorns made red card history in their Friday win over Seattle, as NWSL action saw the Cascadia Rivalry turn over a new leaf.

item.title: JPMorgan Chase Teams Up with Women's Sports Stars for Athlete Initiative
item.description: JPMorgan Chase is aiming to help players win the financial game, launching a legend-laden Athlete Council last week.

item.title: Wisconsin Hockey Downs Ohio State to Win 2nd Straight NCAA Championship
item.description: Wisconsin did it again, earning a second straight college ice hockey championship by defeating Ohio State in Sunday's Frozen Four final.

item.title: Karolina Muchova Dominates Alexandra Eala at 2026 Miami Open
item.description: Karolina Muchova dominated Alexandra Eala 6-0, 6-2 in just one hour, reaching her first Miami Open quarterfinal with a clinical performance.

item.title: Florida Hires Tammi Reiss as Women's Basketball Coach After March Madness Run
item.description: Florida hired Tammi Reiss as its new women's basketball coach, after the A-10 Coach of the Year led Rhode Island to the 2026 NCAA tournament.

item.title: After Loss to UConn Women's Basketball, Syracuse Coach Blasts NCAA
item.description: Syracuse coach Felisha Legette-Jack criticized the NCAA, after repeatedly sharing a March Madness bracket with UConn women's basketball.

item.title: Coco Gauff Reaches First Miami Open Quarterfinal, Completes WTA 1000 Milestone
item.description: Coco Gauff defeated Sorana Cirstea to reach her first Miami Open quarterfinals, completing a career sweep of all 10 WTA 1000 quarterfinals.

item.title: Nelly Korda Heads To Ford Championship After Heartbreaking Founders Cup Loss
item.description: Nelly Korda is looking to bounce back from Sunday's tight Founders Cup loss, as the world No. 2 gears up for this week's Ford Championship.

item.title: Lower Seeds Virginia, Notre Dame Shake Up 2026 Women's March Madness Bracket
item.description: Women's March Madness is giving way to Cinderella stories, as Virginia and Notre Dame upset higher seeds to punch tickets to the Sweet 16.

item.title: No. 1 Seeds Dominate Women's March Madness Bracket En Route to Sweet 16
item.description: The NCAA's best are barreling through the Women's March Madness bracket, with all four No. 1 seeds advancing to this year's Sweet 16.

item.title: Champions League Quarterfinals Kick Off in London
item.description: Chelsea and Arsenal will kick off the 2025/26 Champions League quarterfinals on Tuesday, despite shorthanded rosters for the first-leg match.

item.title: North American Tennis Stars Show Off at 2026 Miami Open
item.description: The US and Canada are showing out, with every women's singles quarterfinal at the 2026 Miami Open featuring a North American tennis star.

item.title: 2028 WNBA Expansion Team Cleveland Grows Ownership Group with Monarch Investment
item.description: A full two years out from tipoff, the incoming Cleveland WNBA franchise added high-profile investors to its ownership roster this week.
